summary: This note is an introduction to a Wikipedia list of accolades for The Lord of the Rings film series, focusing on the first film, The Fellowship of the Ring. It states the film's Academy Award and British Academy Film Awards results and names several other ceremonies and critics groups that recognized it. In total the film won 98 awards from 152 nominations.
one_line: Summary of the awards and nominations received by The Fellowship of the Ring, the first Lord of the Rings film.
key_facts: The Fellowship of the Ring received thirteen Academy Award nominations.
The Fellowship of the Ring won four Academy Awards.
The Fellowship of the Ring received thirteen nominations at the 55th British Academy Film Awards.
At the 55th British Academy Film Awards, The Fellowship of the Ring won awards for Best Film, Best Direction, Best Special Visual Effects, and the Orange Film of the Year Award.

Other ceremonies that gave The Fellowship of the Ring much recognition included the American Film Institute Awards, the Broadcast Film Critics Association Awards, the Empire Awards, the Golden Globes, the MTV Movie Awards, the Satellite Awards, and Saturn Awards.
Critics groups in Chicago and Phoenix also awarded The Fellowship of the Ring.
In total, The Fellowship of the Ring received 98 awards out of 152 nominations.
